items.title: Dick Hyman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Back in 1950, I got tapped to play with his sextet on a European tour.

ctx.x: What was it like playing with some of the jazz legends? I mean is there one or two people that stood out in your mind from all the people you’ve played with over the years. I know you’ve played with Dizzy, and —

Well Benny Goodman certainly. Back in 1950, I got tapped to play with his sextet on a European tour. I was 23. And now that I think of it, Benny wasn’t any more than in his 40’s at that time, and we thought of him as the grand old man.
He’d already had his whole swing thing.
